fusions.name: Death Roll
fusions.desc: Clamps onto an enemy at or below 30% health and rolls, dealing 24 damage and consuming every affliction on it, adding 1.6 times their remaining damage. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Drop and Clamp
fusions.desc: You rush an enemy up to 5 tiles away and clamp down for 15 damage, rising to 1.5 times that from the full 5 tiles, and stun it for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Hang Still
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 30% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Waiting Jaws
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds; once every 10 seconds. You have 25% more critical chance against enemies that have not been hurt yet.
